headquarters.en: No permanent secretariat (rotating chairship: India 2026, China 2027); its New Development Bank is in Shanghai
headquarters.zh: 無常設秘書處（輪值主席國：2026年印度、2027年中國）；所屬新開發銀行總部設於上海

nature.en: Informal intergovernmental grouping of major emerging economies
nature.zh: 主要新興經濟體的非正式政府間合作機制

purpose.en: Large emerging economies of the 'Global South' cooperate on trade, finance and development and push for a bigger voice in global institutions such as the IMF and World Bank. The name comes from Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa.
purpose.zh: 「全球南方」的大型新興經濟體在貿易、金融與發展上合作，並爭取在國際貨幣基金、世界銀行等全球機構中更大的發言權。名稱取自巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國與南非的英文字首。

members.note: Ambiguous: invited in 2023 and listed by official BRICS (Brazil 2025, India 2026) sites as a full member effective 1 Jan 2024, but Riyadh has never publicly confirmed formal accession; attended the Sept 2026 New Delhi summit only via its foreign minister as an invitee.

notes: 11 full members (counting Saudi Arabia) and 10 partner countries as of 2026; no new members/partners admitted at the 18th summit (New Delhi, 12-13 Sept 2026).
Indonesia became a full member on 6 January 2025 (announced by Brazil's chairship).

Partner category created at the Kazan summit (Oct 2024); Belarus, Bolivia, Cuba, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Thailand, Uganda, Uzbekistan joined 1 Jan 2025, Nigeria 17 Jan 2025, Vietnam June 2025 (joined years for the first eight recorded as 2025).

Saudi Arabia judgement: kept as 'member' following the official BRICS/Indian government lists, with caveat that its accession is unconfirmed by Riyadh (Reuters). Front-end may wish to style it differently.
Argentina was invited in 2023 but declined (Dec 2023) and is not listed. BRICS started as BRIC (first summit 2009); South Africa joined 2010/2011.
